# Jose Ortiz

> IT Documentation, DevOps guides, and technical articles by Jose Ortiz.

This site hosts comprehensive setup guides, documentation, and how-tos for macOS configuration, Python, Git, Networking, Observability, and Authentication.

## Core Documentation

- [macOS Setup Guide Introduction](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide.md): Get started with a clean, automatable macOS configuration.
- [macOS Base System Setup](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/base-system-setup-macos.md): System preferences, settings, and initial system adjustments.
- [macOS Terminal Setup](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/terminal-setup-macos.md): Configuring Ghostty, fonts, and terminal styling.
- [macOS SSH & Authentication](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/ssh-and-authentication.md): 1Password SSH Agent integration and key generation.
- [macOS Git & Version Control](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/git-and-version-control.md): Configuring Git, GPG, and credentials.
- [macOS Shell CLI Tooling](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/shell-cli-tooling.md): Recommended developer utilities (eza, bat, fzf, fd, ripgrep).
- [macOS Shell Usability](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/shell-usability-improvements.md): Configuring zsh, zoxide, and shell completions.
- [macOS Prompt & UX](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/prompt-and-ux.md): Custom prompt configuration with Starship.
- [macOS Secrets & Environment](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/secrets-and-environment-management.md): Using direnv and managing environment variables.
- [macOS Python & Automation](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/python-and-automation-tooling.md): Setting up Python, mise, and pipx.
- [macOS Kubernetes & DevOps](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/kubernetes-and-devops-tooling.md): Installing docker, colima, k3d, and Kubernetes CLI tools.
- [macOS Neovim Setup](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/editor-setup-neovim.md): Setting up Neovim with LazyVim or custom config.
- [macOS Dotfiles & Reproducibility](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/macos-setup-guide/dotfiles-and-reproducibility.md): Managing dotfiles with chezmoi.

## Python Guides

- [Python Environments with direnv](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/python-environment-direnv.md): Best practices for python virtualenvs with direnv.
- [Python Threading & Blocking I/O](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/python-threads-blocking-io.md): Under-the-hood look at Python threading and OS scheduling.
- [In-Process Cache in Python](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/python-inmemory-cache.md): Designing a thread-safe in-memory cache in Python.

## Git Tutorials

- [Git Rebase Without Fear](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/git/rebase-without-fear.md): Interactive rebase workflows explained visually.
- [Git Rebase Cheat Sheet](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/git/rebase-cheat-sheet.md): Command reference and quick recipes.

## How-To Guides

- [AWS Route 53 Subdomain Delegation](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/create-delegated-subdomain-aws-route53-hosted-zone.md): Setting up subdomain DNS delegation.
- [Splitting Route 53 Hosted Zones](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/splitting-aws-route53-hosted-zone-into-delegated-subdomains.md): Safely migrating zone records to subdomains.
- [Recording Terminal to SVG](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/how-to/recording-terminal-to-svg-with-termsvg.md): High-fidelity terminal recording using termsvg.
- [Switching to mise](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/how-to/direnv-to-mise.md): Migrating shell environments from direnv to mise.
- [Migrating to pyproject.toml](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/how-to/pyproject-toml-migration.md): Modern packaging standards for Python.

## Observability

- [Observability Basics](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/observability/observability-basics.md): Core concepts of logs, metrics, and traces.
- [Memory Usage vs Working Set Size](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/observability/memory-usage-vs-working-set.md): Troubleshooting Linux memory stats.

## Networking

- [Quick Networking Commands](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/networking/networking-quick-commands.md): Quick reference for dig, curl, ss, ip, and ping.
- [Troubleshooting Commands by Problem](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/networking/troubleshooting-commands-by-problem.md): Diagnostic recipes for network issues.
- [Why Linux Interface Names Look Weird](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/networking/linux-interface-names.md): Systemd predictable network interface names.
- [OSI Layers Explained](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/networking/osi-layers-explained.md): Explaining the network stack in plain English.
- [What is a Forward Proxy](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/networking/what-is-a-forward-proxy.md): Definition, use-cases, and architecture.
- [What is a Reverse Proxy](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/networking/what-is-a-reverse-proxy.md): Load balancing, SSL termination, and security routing.

## Authentication

- [Keycloak Centralized Auth](https://www.joseoc.dev/raw/authentication/keycloak-centralized-authentication.md): Single Sign-On setup with Keycloak.
